linkedin.headline: UX researcher | Quillmark Studio
linkedin.about: I study how people actually behave with products and then argue for them with evidence. I am curious about psychology, travel and the stories behind ordinary habits. I bikepack through new places whenever I can and I get itchy feet if I stay put for too long. Hoping to meet someone who is up for spontaneous trips.

experience.title: Senior UX Researcher
experience.description: Lead interview studies and usability tests for consumer apps.

experience.title: Research Associate
experience.description: Ran field studies on commuter behaviour.

instagram.bio: Gravel bike, bad puns, good maps. Packing for the next ride.

posts.caption: Bikepacking weekend in Wales, 160km and one very wet tent. Tent puns are inevitable.
Camping above the clouds. Fresh air, zero signal, perfect.
Planning the next route over way too much coffee. Where should we go?
Dad jokes are my love language and I will not be taking questions.
